description: Encode verified pharmacogenomic rules for warfarin (CYP2C9/VKORC1/CYP4F2), tacrolimus (CYP3A5), tamoxifen (CYP2D6), omeprazole (CYP2C19), lansoprazole (CYP2C19), voriconazole (CYP2C19), and irinotecan (UGT1A1). Append rules to data/rules/pgx.json. Add 5 new E-* primary evidence records. Add reference test cases. Independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-003 — purely additive changes to the same files. DEPENDS ON: FEAT-001 having been committed (Windows path fix must already be in place for verification to work).
steps:
STEP 7 — Append IRINOTECAN / UGT1A1 rule to data/rules/pgx.json. No CPIC guideline exists in index.json for irinotecan; use DPWG (PA166104951), RNPGx (PA166127626), and AIOM (PA166312821). Status is 'verified' since G:PA* entries have type 'guideline_annotation' which is not 'secondary_summary'.

  R-PGX-IRINOTECAN-UGT1A1-PM: condition={type:'pgx', gene:'UGT1A1', phenotypeIn:['poor']}, action='modify', headline='Irinotecan dose reduction recommended for UGT1A1 poor metabolizers (*28/*28)', rationale='DPWG recommends dose reductions for irinotecan starting at 70% of the standard starting dose for UGT1A1 *28/*28 homozygotes (poor metabolizers), with increases guided by neutrophil count; RNPGx and AIOM guidelines make similar recommendations.', mechanism='UGT1A1 glucuronidates the active irinotecan metabolite SN-38; reduced UGT1A1 activity (*28/*28) elevates SN-38 exposure, increasing the risk of severe diarrhoea and neutropenia.', monitoring=['Neutrophil count monitoring after each cycle. Dose escalation only if toxicity is acceptable.'], limitations=['TODO: For UGT1A1 intermediate metabolizers (*28/*1), dose adjustment recommendations vary across guidelines and are not encoded in this version. Re-check G:PA166104951 and G:PA166127626 for guidance on intermediate phenotype.'], evidence=['G:PA166104951','G:PA166127626','G:PA166312821'], alternatives={supported:false}
